name: orca-01-call-contour
title: One call, drawn as a contour
text: Onset 891 Hz, plateau 1261 Hz with a 8.5 Hz wobble at 4.3% depth, terminal 895 Hz, over 1.6 s. Synthesised from seed 101; a real catalogued type is defined by a shape like this one, not by this one.

name: orca-02-call-family
title: Four types, side by side
text: Four contours from seeds 101–104. Plateau-to-terminal drop ranges 366–775 Hz across the set. Discreteness is the claim worth keeping: types are countable, which is what makes acoustic identification possible at all.

name: orca-03-repertoire
title: Who uses which type
text: 3 groups × 4 types, seed 7: 1 type(s) used by every group, 2 held by exactly one. The idea that pods hold overlapping-but-distinct repertoires is Ford’s and is credited on the card; this particular matrix is program output.

name: orca-04-call-match
title: Same type, or not?
text: Contour 101 against contour 102: 0.142 octaves mean separation, against 0.000 for a contour matched with itself. A real classifier does far more than this — HALLO’s is a neural one — but this is the quantity the intuition is reaching for.

name: orca-05-forecast-t0
title: Tick 0: everything starts in one place
text: t = 0.0 s, tick 0 of 300. Ensemble spread 0.0 px around a centroid at (230, 560). θ = 0.55, σ = 14.0, preferred cruise 42.0 px/s, heading blend 0.72/0.28.

name: orca-06-forecast-mid
title: Tick 150: mid run
text: t = 15.0 s, tick 150 of 300. Ensemble spread 184.0 px around a centroid at (797, 484). θ = 0.55, σ = 14.0, preferred cruise 42.0 px/s, heading blend 0.72/0.28.

name: orca-07-forecast-end
title: Tick 300: end of run
text: t = 30.0 s, tick 300 of 300. Ensemble spread 220.9 px around a centroid at (1014, 329). θ = 0.55, σ = 14.0, preferred cruise 42.0 px/s, heading blend 0.72/0.28.

name: orca-08-ship-strike
title: The same ensemble, against a hazard band
text: 2 of 24 paths end inside the band at t = 30.0 s. The band is a circle on an empty field on purpose: it is not a channel, not a shipping lane, not a map of anywhere. The output of a real system is a probability over a real place, and this is not one.

name: orca-09-sound-families
title: Three families of sound
text: Clicks for echolocation, whistles for tonal contact, pulsed calls for the catalogued repertoire. Standard taxonomy, credited on the card; the drawings are schematic, and the source-identification framing is HALLO’s. Not affiliated with SFU or HALLO.

name: orca-10-false-positive
title: The rule that looked fine
text: 160 synthetic events at threshold 0.62: 33 calls caught, 30 false alarms of which 30 are boats, 8 calls missed. A boat is loud in band too. This is the card that replaced a confusion matrix, because a matrix reads as a result no matter what the caption underneath it says.
